reproduction_script:
import argparse, hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
sys.path.insert(0, 'armport/scripts')
from reviewed_asset_coverage import load_manifest
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('--assets',type=Path,required=True); p.add_argument('--errors',type=Path,required=True); a=p.parse_args()
plan=json.load(open('armport/evidence/m3-proposed-plaza-statue-materials.json'))
raw=(a.assets/'client-visual-manifest.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+b'\0'+raw).hexdigest()==plan['sources']['client-visual']['git_blob']
doc,decoded=load_manifest(a.assets/'client-visual-manifest.json')
assert decoded==plan['sources']['client-visual']['decoded'] and doc['archive']==plan['sources']['client-visual']['archive']
errors_raw=a.errors.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(errors_raw).hexdigest()==plan['client_errors_sha256']
errors=json.loads(errors_raw); assert errors['complete_messages'] and not errors['integrity_failures']
for path,pin in plan['files'].items():
    request=pin['request']; key=request.removesuffix('.tga').casefold()
    matches={n:v for n,v in doc['files'].items() if n.startswith('data/texture_library/') and PurePosixPath(n).suffix=='.texture' and PurePosixPath(n).stem.casefold()==key}
    assert matches=={path:{k:pin[k] for k in ('bytes','sha256')}}
    rows=[r for r in errors['outside_errors'] if ('"'+request+'"') in r['text'] or r['text'].endswith(' texture '+request)]
    assert rows==pin['errors'] and sum(r['count'] for r in rows)==pin['error_occurrences']
assert sum(v['bytes'] for v in plan['files'].values())==plan['payload_bytes']==2306838
assert sum(v['error_occurrences'] for v in plan['files'].values())==plan['literal_error_occurrences']==27
print('6 unique existing visual-manifest files, 2306838 bytes, 27 literal errors; proposal only, no staging')
